description.value:
You target a hostile creature within range with a debilitating pulse of the dark side. The target makes a Constitution saving throw; on a failure it gains 1 slowed level until the power ends, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect early.

At 5th level you can target two creatures, at 11th level three, and at 17th level four, each requiring a separate saving throw.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, At-Will
